content.comment_body: Regarding unit [article_no]: I have firmware version [version_no] on this device. I downloaded the file logo_fw_v1_81_03_up_bm.zip, verified the checksum to confirm it wasn't corrupted, and extracted the ZIP archive so the SD card contains two files: up_bm.bin and [product_name]_U_P.bin. I expected the device to begin updating after powering off and back on, but it simply starts up normally with no update. I assume the downloaded file includes firmware [version_no], and my device should begin the update process.
Your device is a first generation [product_name] [article_no], which cannot be updated. See the attached text file for details.

analysis.insight_summary: A user tries to update firmware on a [product_name] unit with standard procedures, confirming the file's integrity, but the update does not start. Another user explains that this hardware version is not upgradable, exposing a product limitation not clearly indicated in either the update procedure or documentation. This points to a gap in communication about hardware compatibility and firmware upgradability.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects the device to detect update files from the SD card and initiate the firmware update process during reboot, resulting in an improved firmware version.
